summary: Iteration 10: tested the SOCProfessionals Academy rebrand and the badge email (backend and frontend). Backend: new pytest file with 15 passing tests and 1 skipped (no certificates in the DB). Earlier suites (bonus/share, alerts/badges, main API) were updated to the new emails and pass: 44 passed, 1 skipped. Badge email checked end to end. A fresh student at delivered+badge...@resend.dev marked course 585979 watched, then solved ctf-net-2. The progress call then returned awarded=1 and the backend log shows 'POST .../email/send 202 Accepted'. No second email on a repeat progress or dashboard call. No email when course_emails is false. A captured in-process run of send_badge_email confirmed the email contents: badge PNG img, LinkedIn share-offsite with the encoded share url, 'Share on LinkedIn', the unsubscribe link and the brand. It also passes the _assert_safe_email check. The unsubscribe link sets course_emails to false. Frontend: the browser tab title and the brand logo (SOC / Professionals / ACADEMY) are correct. No SOCForge text on /, /courses, /catalog, /talent, /login, /register, /app, /app/drill, /app/courses, /app/certificates, /app/billing, /app/kali, /app/ctf. The Kali prompt is analyst@socpro-kali. The dashboard switch reads 'Email me about new courses & badges'. Regressions pass: course grid (13 cards), course popup, My courses and the share dialog (LinkedIn link and a 1200px image). ONE BUG: /u/demo still shows 'Join SOCForge'.

Optional: update the meta description in public/index.html
critical_code_review_comments: In core.send_email, _assert_safe_email runs outside the try. If it raises inside the asyncio.create_task badge email, the error only shows as 'Task exception was never retrieved' and is not logged as a warning. Consider wrapping it in try/except or logging it.
asyncio.create_task in courses_progress keeps no reference to the task, so it can be garbage-collected before it finishes (rare). Consider BackgroundTasks or keeping a reference in a set.
rebrand() skips a @socforge.io user if the target email already exists. That user keeps the old email (none exist now).
seed_data_creation: Test students delivered+badge/off/unsub*@resend.dev are created and cleaned up by the module fixture. The in-process HTML test may give the seeded demo student a share_token (harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_socforge_api.py needs REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported or it fails at collection. Other files fall back to frontend/.env. No certificates exist in the DB, so the PDF test is skipped; the PDF header '> SOCPROFESSIONALS ACADEMY' was confirmed by code review. The certificates page had no certificates, so the LinkedIn organizationName link was confirmed by code review only (Account.jsx).
